0022600182.text: The Nuggets (3-3, 1-2 at home) are 2 games back in the Northwest and 10th in the West after a loss in their most recent game, while the Raptors (4-3) sit 4th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, and are on a one-game winning streak. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), with Jakob Poeltl listed as day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Nuggets won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 121-115 home win over Toronto on March 20, 2026.
